#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::cin >> input;
    int count = 0;
    
    for (int start = 0; start < input.length(); ) {
        char current = input[start];
        int end = start;
        while (end < input.length() && input[end] == current) {
            end++;
        }
        int run = end - start;
        if (run % 2 == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        start = end;
    }
    
    std::cout << count;
    return 0;
}
